review.evidence: Sygnum describes one FIUSD per subscribed Fidelity ILF unit, token burn when the unit is sold, and a daily internal report comparing Core Banking System, database and blockchain records. This supports internal-ledger process semantics only, not financial assurance. The two current native supplies are 1517.66 zkSync and zero Arbitrum units, while CoinGecko claims 3997.66. Current operator registries and EIP-1967 implementations were read; no Safe, timelock, full minter/system roster or independently reconciled reserve cap is credited.
unresolvedQuestions: Close operator/system members and ultimate root/proxy administration on both deployments.
Independently verify zkSync deployed implementation source and all latent mint paths.
Explain the 2480-unit provider/native discrepancy with a current token-to-fund-unit reconciliation.
Publish the native cross-chain reallocation and burn conservation policy.
